verdict.rationale: Firecrawl offers research-agent building blocks: an agent that searches and retrieves without URLs, an adjustable reasoning-effort setting, search with full page content, and schema-driven structured JSON output. Nothing shows a named preset tuned for research agents or output that carries source citations, so the user must assemble the configuration themselves. Missing for 10: a documented research-agent preset or profile, citable output with source URLs or attributions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
